notes.title: Confirming Steam Controller Input Settings
notes.content:
With the release of Ver.1.5.0 on 3/13/2024, a fix for an issue in which analog input did not work as intended has been implemented.
Consequently, we have updated the button layout to allow for the analog input.

Please confirm whether the updated button layout has been applied or not using the following procedure.
[olist]
[*] Please select "METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version" from your Steam library. 
[*] Open "Controller Layout" by selecting the controller icon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/af62621c060f99a2f28347b4f0316050c3669edc.png[/img]
[*] Select the gear icon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/7fb0f7ced788f88f8ef9fdaa34f5aaa1bb643afd.png[/img]
[*] Select "Layout Details".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/c01cd35f95bd47d0d4454ec671e5236ac87897b4.png[/img]
[*] Please confirm that the "Layout ID" is one of the following ID numbers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/15d2ee4744960c3a2c1162fa373068bb2858739c.png[/img]
*The number will differ depending on the type of controller being used.

[list]
[b][*] 3151547762
[*] 3151614843
[*] 3151617087
[*] 3151625643
[*] 3151626740
[*] 3151629784
[*] 3161667775[/b]
[/list][/olist]
If the ID number does not match any of the above, please verify the integrity of game's files.

To verify the integrity of the game's files, please use the following procedure.
[olist]
[*] Please select "METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version" from your Steam library. 
[*] Select the gear icon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/d1ec8e9f4d7a17168c78d454e88cc3a896a3d24f.png[/img]
[*] Select "Properties".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/fd8ceea06f91c1a5b1baa5d152198fec3234eca8.png[/img]
[*] Select "Installed Files".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/c34567369b76e6846360fe4b5577f65009cc3192.png[/img]
[*] Select "Verify integrity of game files".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/531aac61bd3adf8c0d887d94d885eefb9ffd5f62.png[/img]
[/olist]

We will continue to investigate and work towards addressing analog input issues to the best of our ability.
Please visit our official site and social media accounts for further updates and other information.

notes.title: Announcing Ver.1.5.0
notes.content:
Ver.1.5.0 releases Mar.13.2024.

[h1]Ver.1.5.0 Patch Notes[/h1]
Please check the list of changes below for details on the main improvements and fixes in this patch.
Fixes of previously known issues are marked with an asterisk.
[list]
- Fixed an issue in which certain cutscenes stopped playing*
- Fixed an issue in which analog input did not work as intended*
- Removed the "Download" option from the main menu
- Changed it so that Window Mode settings cannot be altered on Steam Deck™
- Fixed some other minor issues
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing Ver.1.4.0
notes.content:
Ver.1.4.0 releases Dec. 20th, 2023.

[h1]Ver.1.4.0 Patch Notes[/h1]
Please check the list of changes below for details on the main improvements and fixes in this patch.

[h3]- Added new screen setting features[/h3]
Added the following features.
The settings for each of these features can be changed both before and during gameplay.

[b]1. Smoothing[/b]
Can be turned ON or OFF.
Smooths the picture when turned ON, generates a sharp picture when turned OFF.

Settings Screen - Before Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/f8ff0d3afd4eb5c9e6f18737339755483e12a9f0.png[/img]
Settings Screen - During Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/067c269c96efd25bf1d8c4068b8b8f5e3efe93e6.png[/img]
Example of the screen when turned ON
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/946b59cf6bc621f49446781d4e208267ee10e757.png[/img]
Example of the screen when turned OFF (New!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/13b4c76af381536e287041a74122440b225bdf93.png[/img]

[b]2. Game Screen Settings[/b]
Can be set to a total of 4 settings—“Standard”, “Pixel Perfect”, “16:9”, or “Fullscreen”.
Wallpaper, display area, and screen filter features are also available when using the “Standard” or “Pixel Perfect” features.
The aspect ratio displayed may differ based on the settings or particulars of your device/setup.

Settings Screen - Before Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/87483711d5b6aa2239e2e12c3102b06f7d3c194c.png[/img]
Settings Screen - During Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/6689a2e60de7322946aeb21d0d68742c1580c532.png[/img]
Example of the screen when set to “Standard”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/13137089c0ccaef9b101e790491fd6408fb8ae66.png[/img]
Example of the screen when set to “Pixel Perfect”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/6ccb31c4af30b258b4d1edb91597e7160df11f8e.png[/img]
Example of the screen when set to “16:9”
*The original game’s picture (including when letterboxed) will be stretched to fit the 16:9 aspect ratio, in accordance with the aspect ratio of your screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/7de8299dca621f7732a39d90f71544023d56c1c6.png[/img]
Example of the screen when set to “Fullscreen”
*The original game’s picture (including when letterboxed) will be stretched to fit the maximum possible aspect ratio.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/a79343e2871b765e05bad340633ac47dc8433f14.png[/img]

[b]3. Screen Filter[/b]
Can be turned ON or OFF.
Applies a filter that displays scanlines like those on a CRT TV when turned ON.

Settings Screen - Before Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/9fd2d0beb3b5b53bedfe12730b6f44043a406a9e.png[/img]
Settings Screen - During Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/fcfadf6f60711176ec4b130ab0b8c18f7bdd055b.png[/img]
Example of the screen when turned ON (New!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/8397f1fc15aef2a0f14bf3f6c556dc9682032c48.png[/img]
Example of the screen when turned OFF
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/5b6966f42a214a568634fd9f06fe41efb2f553d4.png[/img]

[h3]- Added an audio settings feature[/h3]
Settings for the game volume and main menu volume can be changed prior to play.
Only the game volume can be changed during play.

Settings Screen - Before Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/1fdea0b50b1837251768eab8d68329d08e87d990.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/a3bf54e5eca7f71163232b678870348903824670.png[/img]
Settings Screen - During Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/7ec7060da472e9cebd16e972f02aa02365f0b9ac.png[/img]

[h3]- Added a controller response speed customization feature[/h3]
Can choose between “Fast” (new!) and “Stable”.
Some setups may experience unstable performance when set to “Fast”.
If you experience any such issues, please change your settings to “Stable”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/14f477ac579f96ce7a55495d76bad72b27a8bd7a.png[/img]
[h3]
- Applied fix to have the game give priority to user set button designs

- Fixed some other minor issues
[/h3]


[h1]Issues Under Investigation[/h1]
We are investigating the issues below and working to resolve them.
We will provide further details regarding fixes for these issues at a later time.

- An issue in which certain cutscenes stop playing

- An issue in which analog input does not work as intended


We will continue to provide regular updates on future improvements and fixes 
as further details are finalized.

notes.title: Ver. 1.2.2 Beta Update Notice
notes.content:
We have released a beta update that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2131630/view/3705959047636011519]resolves the abnormal speed issue[/url]. However, as this is a beta update there is a possibility that it may cause other issues to occur, and as such, we ask for your understanding. If this happens, please opt out of the beta and revert to the original release version.
Follow the steps below to opt into the beta.
[olist]
[*] Go to your Library from within the Steam Client and select “METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/100da4c2da645e9be54c4b630f631e5493e6f470.png[/img]
[*] Right click and select “Properties”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/28ae3d71ac9e12f752ad533416825fd4f378b939.png[/img]
[*]  Select “Betas” and input "[b]n5aYRbUiiNS6[/b]" into the bar under "Private Betas" section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/11a0ad4fa3a1ffe2e47477d63da3287eff642c5e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/bb8928dd85442b981c6de309d85dec3025072098.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/b6f9872574e0eebef82e2b157e3b4dee726fe305.png[/img]
If successful, "Opt into: beta - beta test" will be displayed in blue underneath the bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/3abac5f0cc8970e77a8948eaa8530cc7768c1640.png[/img]
The option to select "beta" from the dropdown menu in "Beta Participation" will then become available.
Once selected, the beta update will download.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/36abc37b749d4eb06b5bc331f6ef3b0ed5c84f4d.png[/img]
You will be able to play the beta version once the download is complete.
To revert to the original release version, simply change “beta” back to “None” in the dropdown menu. Once the download reverting the beta update is complete, you will be able to play the original release version.
[*] For those who are tried and are using the temporary solution, make sure to reset the settings to the original settings first before launching the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: How to install the DLCs
notes.content:
[h1]How to install the DLCs[/h1]

[h2]Disclaimers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Currently, there is a known issue where users are unable to install the DLC when selecting the "Download" button from within the game.
This "Download" button will be removed in a future update.
[*] Make sure that you close the game app before installing/uninstalling the DLC.
Make sure to also wait until the install/uninstall is complete before launching the game app.
[*] The list of DLCs that are available will vary depending on which regional version of the game you own. The screenshot displayed in these instructions are based on the European regional version. The details can be found in the DLC section of your Steam Client.
[/list]

[olist]
[*] Go to your Library from within the Steam Client and select "METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/100da4c2da645e9be54c4b630f631e5493e6f470.png[/img]
[*] Right click and select "Properties"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/28ae3d71ac9e12f752ad533416825fd4f378b939.png[/img]
[*] Go to the DLC section, select the DLC that you would like to install, and deselect the ones you don't want to install.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/dc403a2fcf22691a1b00a78f9c54d6ad24c3c334.png[/img]
This setting can be changed at any point in time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/eb00f3797f4490c10fb0f4f3f6cb62b12e9b985e.png[/img]
[/olist]

notes.title: Workaround for when the game is running at high speeds
notes.content:
We are aware that users are reporting issues with the Steam® version of METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1 resulting in the game running at abnormal speeds.
We ask for your patience while we conduct a thorough investigation.

We recommend that you try the following workaround as a temporary solution.
[b]This workaround is not necessary if you are not experiencing these issues. [/b]

[h2]Instructions[/h2]
[h3]For those using a graphics card made by NVIDIA® [/h3]
We recommend that you follow these steps below.
The screen configuration, etc. may be different depending on the which version you have installed.
[olist]
[*] Open the “NVIDIA Control Panel”, then select the “Manage 3D settings” located on the left-side of the window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/0f2a33be82c4e1d45fbe5271612f63873943260d.png[/img]
[*] Select the “Program Settings” tab.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/90745920558916540ac73ef95d13faa047bd8c5e.png[/img]
[*] In the “1. Select a program to customize:” section click on the “Add” button, then go to the folder where you have “METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version” installed and select “METAL GEAR SOLID.exe”.
Once selected, make sure that the file location is displayed on the right-side of the “Add” button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/fe64bb1d4c77abe5d81893101db86b2812d79f0e.png[/img]
[*] In the “2. Specify the settings for this program:” section, make sure that the “Vertical sync” is turned on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/b037b3e0d59b26b51d16d4edc8b7b341163fecc5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/b10e50e40fbb2dc4bbfca00988918b839ac08d61.png[/img]
[*] In the “2. Specify the settings for this program:” section, make sure that the “Max Frame Rate” is at 60FPS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/5d10569a733e0643a766be78918cb6908a1d12c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/fb117b5ecbd94b1eeb539e548dc70afc507296a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/3a172a9897a9fd6199123ae496b30aed77f3d77f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/db3bc4e5039ff3c69e1dbec42f2883e00d9edb99.png[/img]
[*] Click the “Apply” button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/87c733cac11764b73bfd7d000f0416c543fd18d1.png[/img]
[/olist]

[h3] For those using a graphics card made by AMD [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Launch the “AMD Software” that you have installed.
[*] In the “Gaming” tab, select “METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/8f5f0122236db7f7bd2104986fe47cb83c36017d.png[/img]
[*] Make sure that the “Radeon™ Chill” is turned on, with the Min FPS and Max FPS set to 60.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/4df3617b9ed49de287ed4144a2dea04c237df077.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/5a358e9b8fdf199fc31c9917d8df6a2234c2a39d.png[/img]
[*] Make sure that the “Wait for Vertical Refresh” is set to Always on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/b89432f0270e964444ead2c330767ca95101aa5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/cd4160ce174a410025c00763f55a8c28551fb777.png[/img]
[/olist]
